_doc: Reference for the contextual growth recipes intent_map.py produces. The brief selects a mode; grow_vine.autofit() rescales budget/attractors/base_r/growth_dz to the mesh bbox (params here are tuned for a ~6 m target). Edit intent_map.BASE to change defaults.

organic_outside.feel: vine creeps in from beyond the silhouette and mats over the surface

organic_inside.trigger: 'from inside', 'from the surface', 'sprouting/erupting out of the mesh'
organic_inside.seed_origin: on-surface scatter seeds (scatter_seeds high, n_seeds low)
organic_inside.feel: vine emerges from the mesh surface itself

vortex.seed_origin: spiral arm mouths winding into the centre

note: Leaf species require the BagaIvy Blender addon to be installed (it is the leaf-card source library). Bark sets live in scripts/assets/bark/.
